content.comment_body: Hello, Previously earlier versions of [product_name] included a memory or battery backup, for example: [article_no]. See [url]. However, I can't find an equivalent for the latest [product_name] version. Is there any alternative solution?
No, the current [product_name] does not have a battery. Program data is stored in flash memory, and you can also use a micro SD card for storage.

That’s right, there isn’t a battery module for the latest [product_name]. All retentive data is stored without any separate module, and the internal clock will typically remain powered for about 20 days. If you need a reliable clock beyond that duration, you'll need to prevent power interruptions, for example by using a UPS (uninterrupted power supply unit).
Thank you for your help. From your explanation, the internal clock continues to run correctly for up to 20 days during a power outage. If a longer duration is needed, using a UPS becomes necessary.
There is a small ultra capacitor on the main board, which maintains the memory and clock during power loss.
Actually, for program and parameter memory, flash memory is used. The capacitor only supports the clock retention.
Yes, that's correct [user_name], my mistake. Mixing beer and browsing forums is not always the best idea.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking details about backup options for the latest [product_name] module, which previous versions had through battery support. Concerns focus on how long the clock and memory are retained during power outages. The responses clarify that the current module uses flash memory and a capacitor to retain data and maintain the clock for around 20 days, but continuous real-time clock functionality during longer outages requires an external UPS. Some confusion about hardware details is resolved throughout the discussion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the latest [product_name] to keep real-time clock and memory data during power outages, preferably through a built-in battery or similar method, and are looking for reliable solutions for extended power interruptions.
